BiblicalUsage: yiqqâhâh is the word the Bible uses when it means obedience. In Genesis 49:10, unto him shall the gathering of the people be, and it appears again in Proverbs 30:17.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe yiqqâhâh still tells the truth about God, and I take it as it stands.
